理由: 下一句说保修期已过，Surely（当然在保）与上下文矛盾，疑为听写错误；译文按“可惜不在了”译

原: What did Sara think David was doing…
疑为: What did Sarah think David was doing…
理由: 同一人前后拼作 Sarah / Sara（31 句也是 Sara），译文统一为萨拉

原: I started. / By researching soldiers’ actual personal lives…
疑为: I started by researching soldiers’ actual personal lives…
理由: 第54、55句是一句话，被句号从中间切断

原: Though cocoa seed is not an ingredient of the soda. / They designed their bottle…
疑为: Though cocoa seed is not an ingredient of the soda, they designed their bottle…
理由: 第83、84句是一句话，被句号从中间切断

原: …part of American culture for a century, it was 100 years ago this week that the bottle earned a patent.
疑为: …part of American culture for a century. It was 100 years ago this week that the bottle earned a patent.
理由: 两句之间应为句号，被逗号连成一句

原: …get by on what they grow, the Caribbean produces many things.
疑为: …get by on what they grow. The Caribbean produces many things.
理由: 两句之间应为句号，被逗号连成一句

原: …oil, mineral pitch, and many. / Forest products, Jamaica’s aluminum ore supplies are the world’s largest.
疑为: …oil, mineral pitch, and many forest products. Jamaica’s aluminum ore supplies are the world’s largest.
理由: 句号切错位置：and many forest products 被切断，后面两句又被逗号连在一起

原: The vacationer never has any reason to explore the island, as in most places, those who have money live well indeed.
疑为: The vacationer never has any reason to explore the island. As in most places, those who have money live well indeed.
理由: 两句之间应为句号，被逗号连成一句

原: They were given a choice. / Between receiving a small reward…
疑为: They were given a choice between receiving a small reward…
理由: 第168、169句是一句话，被句号从中间切断

原: “Why would this role be any different for you? / You will probably leave here in six months.
疑为: “Why would this role be any different for you? You will probably leave here in six months.”
理由: 引号只开不合，面试官的心里话到第189句结束；译文在189句末补了后引号

原: …convey the idea that you’re flexible, asking what your role will be, suggests you will limit yourself…
疑为: …convey the idea that you’re flexible. Asking what your role will be suggests you will limit yourself…
理由: 两句之间应为句号，被逗号连成一句；suggests 前的逗号多余
